note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Want it done now", of the markets of every country beyond the 21; then "Retry the blocked market facts once all countries land"): the terms a director works on in U.S. Virgin Islands. Research, retry and web-search subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-markets-world.md, -retry.md, -search.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page. Found 2026-11-04 (layer 4's research, then what it found that the engines didn't read): the DGA's own Basic Agreement reaches the United States' territories and dependencies, so the market follows the DGA's terms; until then nothing was found and the market's terms were unknown, its attempts kept in its register entry, which held the blocker until then.

figures.finding: The DGA's Basic Agreement reaches the US Virgin Islands: its section 17-201 applies it to work on motion pictures based in and performed in the United States, its territories and dependencies included, and the Department of the Interior holds the US Virgin Islands a US territory, under the Interior since 1931. The 2026 Memorandum of Agreement carries the 2023 agreement into the 2026 one (1 July 2026 to 30 June 2030) and leaves 17-201 as it was (its geographical part only reissues a bulletin and amends Sideletter No. 31), so a director there works on the DGA's terms, set as the US's are.

value.agreement: DGA Basic Agreement of 2023, carried into the Basic Agreement of 2026 (2026-07-01 to 2030-06-30)
value.scope: 17-201: motion pictures based in and performed in the United States (including its territories and dependencies)
value.territory: a US territory, under the Interior since 1931

figures.applies: The US Virgin Islands, a director engaged by a DGA signatory, as the life's company is held to be in the US (the engine's reading: the life's company signs where a guild lets a producer sign). A non-signatory's director there has no guild terms; the game doesn't model one.

sources.said: The provisions of this BA shall apply to work on motion pictures based in the United States and performed in the United States (including its territories and dependencies) and Canada; provided, however, that the provisions of this BA shall also apply to work performed by any Employee employed by the Employer in the United States, to direct, or to be a UPM or an Assistant Director or Associate Director on a motion picture based outside the United States (including its territories and dependencies).

The terms of the 2023 BA (including all sideletters) shall be incorporated in the Directors Guild of America Basic Agreement of 2026, except as provided below and subject to conforming changes. … The term of the 2026 BA and the 2026 FLTTA shall be for four (4) years, commencing on July 1, 2026 to and including June 30, 2030. … 4. International Jurisdiction (U-4) A. Geographical Application (U-4.A.) … Modify Sideletter No. 31 to the Basic Agreement as follows:

territory An unincorporated United States insular area, of which there are currently thirteen, three in the Caribbean (Navassa Island, Puerto Rico and the United States Virgin Islands) and ten in the Pacific (American Samoa, Baker Island, Guam, Howland Island, Jarvis Island, Johnston Atoll, Kingman Reef, Midway Atoll, the Northern Mariana Islands and Wake Atoll).
Federal authority over the new U.S. territory was placed in the Department of the Interior in 1931, where it resides.
